# Tinted — the Private Inference Market

> OpenAI-compatible inference where every model runs inside a hardware enclave (TEE). Before each call the gateway verifies the CPU enclave (Intel TDX / AMD SEV-SNP), the GPU enclave (NVIDIA CC), the code, the model weights and the keys. Payments are prepaid USDC on Solana; every response gets an ed25519-signed receipt, anchored hourly on Solana.

## Use it
- Base URL: https://f5cd74b3a21a2ca3cfbdfb072c61c470e18c9924-8787.dstack-pha-prod5.phala.network/v1
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer tnt_...` (create one: `POST /v1/accounts`, no body)
- Chat: `POST /v1/chat/completions` (OpenAI format, stream=false)
- Optional header `x-tinted-require-weights: 1` refuses calls unless model weights are proved
- Response headers: `x-tinted-verified` (proof states), `x-tinted-receipt` (receipt id)

## Endpoints
- GET /v1/models — models and prices (per 1M tokens, USD)
- GET /v1/market — every listing, proof states, whether routed and why not
- GET /v1/verification/{provider}/{model} — full evidence
- GET /v1/receipts/{id} — signed receipt, Merkle proof and Solana tx
- GET /v1/balance, GET /v1/deposit — balance; USDC deposit address and memo
- GET /attestation — the gateway's own TDX quote and bound keys

## Verify
- Source: https://github.com/tintedmarket/tinted-gateway
- Site: https://tinted.market
